idf_defines_note: Baseline's console is the native USB port: what the Arduino IDE's USBMode=default (Hardware CDC and JTAG) and CDCOnBoot=cdc options define.
versions_note: What release Baselines are built with (CI pins the same). flick builds with other installed versions too, but warns.
stop_detect_note: Baseline parks a sketch spinning in an empty while(1) (sketch_loader.c, a supervisor checks the stalled PC) instead of letting the watchdog roll it back (flick test step 4).
